import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import { Area, AreaChart } from "recharts";
import { ChartContainer, ChartTooltip, ChartTooltipContent, DonutSummary } from "@/src/components/ui/chart";
import { ProjectMonitor, projectMonitorDemoData } from "@/src/components/blocks/project-monitor-01";
import "./index.css";

const data = [{ count: 2 }, { count: 4 }];

createRoot(document.getElementById("root")!).render(
  <main>
    <ChartContainer id="existing-page" config={{ count: { label: "Requests", color: "blue" } }} className="h-40">
      <AreaChart data={data}>
        <Area dataKey="count" isAnimationActive={false} />
        <ChartTooltip content={<ChartTooltipContent />} />
      </AreaChart>
    </ChartContainer>
    <DonutSummary aria-label="Existing breakdown" segments={[{ id: "ok", label: "Success", value: 4 }]} />
    <ProjectMonitor data={projectMonitorDemoData} defaultTab="reports" />
  </main>
);
